scheme_name: Marriage Assistance to Normal Persons Marrying Visually Impaired Persons
other_conditions: Normal person must marry a speech and visually impaired person
Both spouses must be above 18 years of age
If either spouse holds a degree or diploma, the assistance amount is increased
benefits_summary: Provides ₹25,000 assistance (₹12,500 National Savings Certificate + ₹12,500 cash) for marriage, increased to ₹50,000 if either spouse has a degree/diploma, along with a certificate of appreciation and an 8 gram gold coin.
